Wins:
- Redwood Dedicated capacity rollout completed for Zone‑us‑west2; customers in pilot saw 20% lower p95 latency on large-context workloads (internal validation + early customer feedback).
- New caching heuristics cut token spend on reranker path by ~12% in canary.

- Cost variance: unanticipated GPU hours in nightly evals pushing forecast ~9% over Q2 plan if unchanged. See section B in attachment. (Owner: Jonas)
- Security evidence for Acme Corp procurement: they asked for retention and SSO proofs before legal sign. We have SOC2 artifacts but need a short summary + contact. (Owner: Laura)

Asks (action and due):
1) Jonas — finalize cost‑trend worksheet and recommended mitigations (batching/eviction tweaks) by Wed 5pm PT. Include expected $ impact and ops runbook.
2) Laura — consolidate Acme’s security evidence + one‑page response for procurement by Thu 12pm PT; we’ll attach to the SOW.
3) Karthik — confirm whether we can add a 99th‑percentile latency line to the QBR chart (data engineering impact). Reply with ETA Wed EOD.
4) Priyom — please draft the QBR talking points for leadership (2 slides) and drop in the Drive link; I’ll review Thurs morning.

Notes on format: keep asks tight — we will use these to build the exec deck. If something needs to be escalated beyond these owners, call it out inline.
